# n8n_projects (Data Source)

Lists every n8n project visible to the API key, including the owner's personal project.

Results are paged internally until the list cursor is exhausted. Team-project APIs require an n8n license that includes `feat:projectRole:admin`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "n8n_projects" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier. Always `projects`.
- `projects` (Attributes List) Projects returned by GET /projects after following pagination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `type` (String) Project type (`team` or `personal`).
